mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rn, inner.* FROM ( SELECT BD.BRD_NO, BD.BRD_CODE, BD.BRD_TITL_NM, BD.BRD_CONT, BD.BRD_PBLS_DTM, BD.BRD_VW_CNT, BD.BRD_END_DTM, BD.BRD_DEL_YN, BD.BRD_CTGRY_GRP_CD, MEM.MBR_ID, MEM.MBR_CD, CODE.CODE_NAME AS BRD_CODE_NAME, (SELECT Q.QNA_STATUS FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS qnaStatus, (SELECT Q.QNA_CTGRY FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS qnaCtgry, (SELECT Q.QNA_ANSWERED_AT FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS qnaAnsweredAt, (SELECT F.FAQ_CTGRY FROM FAQ F WHERE F.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS faqCtgry FROM BOARD BD LEFT JOIN MEMBER MEM ON BD.MBR_CD = MEM.MBR_CD INNER JOIN COMMON_CODE CODE ON CODE.CODE_GROUP = 'BRDCT' AND CODE.CODE_VALUE = BD.BRD_CODE WHERE BD.BRD_DEL_YN = 'N'
AND BD.BRD_CODE = #{detailSearch.brdCode}
AND (BD.BRD_END_DTM IS NULL OR BD.BRD_END_DTM >= TRUNC(SYSDATE))
AND (
BD.BRD_TITL_NM LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.brdTitlNm} || '%'
OR BD.BRD_CONT LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.brdCont} || '%'
)
AND BD.BRD_PBLS_DTM >= TO_DATE(#{detailSearch.brdPblsDtmStart}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND BD.BRD_PBLS_DTM <= TO_DATE(#{detailSearch.brdPblsDtmEnd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FAQ F WHERE F.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO AND F.FAQ_CTGRY = #{detailSearch.faqCtgry} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO AND Q.QNA_CTGRY = #{detailSearch.qnaCtgry} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO AND Q.QNA_STATUS = #{detailSearch.qnaStatus} )
ORDER BY BD.BRD_PBLS_DTM DESC ) inner WHERE ROWNUM <= #{lastRecordIndex} ) WHERE rn >= #{firstRecordIndex}

SELECT BD.BRD_NO, BD.BRD_CODE, BD.BRD_TITL_NM, BD.BRD_CONT, BD.BRD_PBLS_DTM, BD.BRD_VW_CNT, BD.BRD_END_DTM, BD.BRD_DEL_YN, BD.BRD_CTGRY_GRP_CD, MEM.MBR_ID, MEM.MBR_CD, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_GROUP = 'BRDCT' AND CODE_VALUE = BD.BRD_CODE) AS BRD_CODE_NAME, (SELECT Q.QNA_STATUS FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS QNA_STATUS, (SELECT Q.QNA_CTGRY FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS QNA_CTGRY, (SELECT Q.QNA_CONT FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS QNA_CONT, (SELECT Q.ANSWER_CONT FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS ANSWER_CONT, (SELECT Q.QNA_ANSWERED_AT FROM QNA Q WHERE Q.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS QNA_ANSWERED_AT, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_GROUP = 'QNA_STATUS' AND CODE_VALUE = (SELECT QNA_STATUS FROM QNA WHERE BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO)) AS QNA_STATUS_NAME, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_GROUP = 'QNA_CTGRY' AND CODE_VALUE = (SELECT QNA_CTGRY FROM QNA WHERE BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO)) AS QNA_CTGRY_NAME, (SELECT F.FAQ_CTGRY FROM FAQ F WHERE F.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS FAQ_CTGRY, (SELECT F.FAQ_CNT FROM FAQ F WHERE F.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS FAQ_CNT, (SELECT F.FAQ_YN FROM FAQ F WHERE F.BRD_NO = BD.BRD_NO) AS FAQ_YN FROM BOARD BD LEFT JOIN MEMBER MEM ON BD.MBR_CD = MEM.MBR_CD WHERE BD.BRD_NO = #{brdNo}
mapper.insert:
SELECT TO_CHAR(SEQ_FAQ_ID.NEXTVAL) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO FAQ ( FAQ_ID, BRD_NO, FAQ_CTGRY, FAQ_TITL, FAQ_CONT, FAQ_CNT, FAQ_YN, FAQ_MBR_ID, FAQ_CRE_DTM, FAQ_MOD_DTM, FAQ_CTGRY_GRP_CD, FAQ_YN_GRP_CD ) VALUES ( #{faqId}, #{brdNo}, #{faqCtgry}, #{faqTitl}, #{faqCont}, #{faqCnt}, #{faqYn}, #{faqMbrId}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{faqCtgryGrpCd}, #{faqYnGrpCd} )

SELECT TO_CHAR(SEQ_QNA_ID.NEXTVAL) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO QNA ( QNA_ID, BRD_NO, QNA_CTGRY, QNA_TITL, QNA_CONT, ANSWER_CONT, QNA_STATUS, QNA_YN, QNA_CRE_DTM, QNA_MOD_DTM, QNA_ANSWERED_AT, MBR_CD, ANSWER_ADMIN_ID, QNA_CTGRY_GRP_CD, QNA_STATUS_GRP_CD, QNA_YN_GRP_CD ) VALUES ( #{qnaId}, #{brdNo}, #{qnaCtgry}, #{qnaTitl}, #{qnaCont}, #{answerCont}, #{qnaStatus}, #{qnaYn}, SYSDATE, NULL, #{qnaAnsweredAt}, #{mbrCd}, #{answerAdminId}, #{qnaCtgryGrpCd}, #{qnaStatusGrpCd}, #{qnaYnGrpCd} )
mapper.update: UPDATE FAQ SET FAQ_CTGRY = #{faqCtgry}, FAQ_TITL = #{faqTitl}, FAQ_CONT = #{faqCont}, FAQ_CNT = #{faqCnt}, FAQ_YN = #{faqYn}, FAQ_MOD_DTM = SYSDATE, FAQ_CTGRY_GRP_CD = #{faqCtgryGrpCd}, FAQ_YN_GRP_CD = #{faqYnGrpCd} WHERE FAQ_ID = #{faqId}

UPDATE QNA SET QNA_CTGRY = #{qnaCtgry}, QNA_TITL = #{qnaTitl}, QNA_CONT = #{qnaCont}, ANSWER_CONT = #{answerCont}, QNA_STATUS = #{qnaStatus}, QNA_YN = #{qnaYn}, QNA_MOD_DTM = SYSDATE, QNA_ANSWERED_AT = #{qnaAnsweredAt}, ANSWER_ADMIN_ID = #{answerAdminId}, QNA_CTGRY_GRP_CD = #{qnaCtgryGrpCd}, QNA_STATUS_GRP_CD = #{qnaStatusGrpCd}, QNA_YN_GRP_CD = #{qnaYnGrpCd} WHERE QNA_ID = #{qnaId}
UPDATE BOARD SET BRD_DEL_YN = 'Y' WHERE BRD_NO = #{brdNo} AND BRD_DEL_YN = 'N'
